### My Nameplate
Author: Luann Prater
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-30-2008-11579730.html
Passage: Exodus 28:36
Points:
- Aaron wore a pure gold plate engraved with "Holy to the LORD" on his forehead as a visible mark of consecration.
- Believers are similarly marked by the seal of the Holy Spirit across every part of their lives.
- Openly bearing an identifying label challenges us to reflect carefully on how our attitudes and reactions affect others.
- Rather than concealing faith, Christians are urged to let Christ's light and grace shine through daily conduct.

### Polluted by Holy Motives?
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-jan-8-2011-11643811.html
Passage: Exodus 28:38
Points:
- Exodus 28:38 highlights that sin and selfish motives can defile even our holy deeds and worship.
- Honest reflection reveals that pride, vanity, or indifference often taint religious service.
- The high priest wore the sacred plate on his forehead so Israel's holy gifts would be acceptable to God.
- Jesus fulfills this role as our High Priest, taking away our iniquity and presenting His own holiness before the Father.
